help_text:
📚 COMPLETE COMMAND REFERENCE:

📌 MAIN:
/help — this reference
/mysubs — all your subscriptions

🔗 SUBSCRIPTIONS:
Just send a Trendyol product link to subscribe
/unsubscribe <id> — remove subscription

📊 PRICE ANALYSIS:
/history <id|url> — price history chart
/price_alert <id> <price> — ⭐ GET ALERT AT TARGET PRICE
/setmode <id> <hourly|discount> — hourly or discount-only mode

⚙️ PERSONALIZATION:
/settings quiet <start> <end> — quiet hours (0-23)
/settings price <id> min:<price> max:<price> percent:<percent>
/settings interval <id> <minutes> — notification interval (min. 15)
/language <ru|en|az|tr> — interface language

🔍 OTHER:
/about — about the bot
/ping — connectivity check

💡 EXAMPLES:
/price_alert 5 2500 — alert when price ≤ 2500 TL
/setmode 5 hourly — hourly notifications
/settings quiet 23 7 — quiet hours 23:00-7:00

settings_usage:
Command for notification settings:
/settings quiet <start> <end> — configure quiet hours (0-23)
/settings price <id> min:<price> max:<price> percent:<percent> — configure price alerts
/settings interval <id> <minutes> — notification interval (min 15 minutes)
quiet_hours_usage:
Usage: /settings quiet <start> <end>
Example: /settings quiet 23 7 — quiet hours from 23:00 to 7:00
price_alerts_usage:
Usage: /settings price <id> min:<price> max:<price> percent:<percent>
Example: /settings price 123 min:100 max:500 percent:10
interval_usage:
Usage: /settings interval <id> <minutes>
Example: /settings interval 123 60 — notifications every hour
